title: Owed Attention
subtitle: Care Ethics and the Duties of Professional Advisers — An Ecrivain Sample Dissertation
author: Eleanor S. Whitcombe
premise: Do professional advisers owe their clients a duty of attention that fiduciary law and informed consent do not capture, and how does it differ from paternalism?
audience: Illustrative sample: doctoral students writing a humanities dissertation with an extended argument and discursive footnotes.
